description: This file defines the 'Leaderboard' web page class in an ASP.NET WebForms application. It manages session-based user identification, retrieves user information from a SQL database on page load, and handles navigation button clicks.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: Represents the code-behind for the leaderboard web page, managing user session validation, data retrieval, and navigation within the application.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initialization when the page loads. Checks user session, retrieves user semester info from the database, and stores it in the session.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the user profile page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Placeholder for leaderboard button click event, currently does nothing.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by resetting session ID and redirects to the login page.
